substeps.html: Protect from Ranged is advised. Familiars are not allowed. Equipping the Fremennik round shield drastically reduces Range damage taken from Ice Troll Females. Yak-hide armour drastically reduces Melee damage taken from Ice Troll Males, Runts, and Grunts. If you do not have good Ranged Defence, bring high-healing food. Even with Protect From Ranged active, the trolls quickly deplete your health. The Ice Troll King has a very high defence to ranged, so it is not advised to kill the boss with ranged weapons.
